dogs.title: Dogs
dogs.p: The Puravie line for Dogs was created with carefully selected proteins, offering excellent nutrition. With a delicious taste that wins over even the most demanding palates, it helps acceptance and turns every meal into a moment of pleasure and satisfaction.

cats.title: Cats
cats.p: In the Puravie line for Cats, you’ll find the essential nutrients to promote your feline friend’s health and well-being, with a taste they’ll love. Enriched with natural antioxidants such as vitamin C, vitamin E, and organic selenium, our food helps protect against premature aging.

about.title: Our brand is a warm hug in every kibble!
about.p: Our brand is a warm hug in every kibble!
about.description: Filling the bowl is a ritual full of happiness, joy and fun. This moment is so pure for our four-legged companions that they deserve food that lives up to it. That is why Puravie was born: a new brand, a new purpose and a new approach to pet nutrition. Every ingredient carries a promise of deep care, and our commitment to society reflects our love for the planet. With Puravie, every meal is an act of love.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description: To nurture deep, meaningful relationships with pets and their families, making a difference through quality food and a commitment to society.

commitment.title: Social commitment
commitment.description: When you choose Puravie, you join us on a journey of responsibility and love. Part of every sale supports animal welfare initiatives and social projects. Every serving is a chance to spread love and make a difference.

packaging.title: Our packaging is sustainable
packaging.description1: Our packaging is 100% recyclable and reflects our commitment to the environment.
packaging.description2: We have chosen recyclable materials that can go to separate collection instead of sophisticated zippers or special seals.
packaging.description3: We also use color thoughtfully to reduce environmental impact. In partnership with the EU RECICLO certification, we offset every package produced by supporting recycling cooperatives.
packaging.description4: When you choose PURAVIE, you also support a community dedicated to caring for our planet.

program.title: Satisfaction Program
program.p: Our four-legged family members mean great responsibility, love, and challenge. We know they have their own tastes, and getting the flavor right can be difficult. Don’t forget to always offer the correct nutrition considering size, life stage, and in some cases their specific needs. A complete diet helps your pet enjoy a better quality of life. Follow your veterinarian’s recommendations, always provide fresh water, walks, affection, and lots of love. If your pet doesn’t adapt to our food, don’t worry — we have the 110% Satisfaction campaign — we can exchange it for another variety or offer a refund of the amount paid + 10%. To do so, contact our Customer Service and have on hand:
list: Receipt/invoice from the partner store where you purchased the product
Keep at least 75% of the product in the original package, following the instructions on the packaging
Product within the expiration date printed on the package
